name: Skill Finder
description: Search and browse open agent skills (SKILL.md files) for AI coding agents. Read-only, no authentication.

skills.name: Search skills
skills.description: Keyword search over the skill catalogue with agent, source and install filters plus paging. GET /api/public/v1/skills

skills.name: Get one skill
skills.description: Details and install command for a single skill. GET /api/public/v1/skills/{id}

skills.name: Skills for an agent
skills.description: Curated skills for one agent. GET /api/public/v1/skills/agent/{agent}
